class Fenwick:
    def __init__(self, n):
        self.n = n
        self.bit = [0] * (n + 2)

    def add(self, i, x):
        n = self.n
        while i <= n:
            self.bit[i] += x
            i += i & -i

    def sum(self, i):
        s = 0
        while i > 0:
            s += self.bit[i]
            i -= i & -i
        return s
